topic: Choose a mascot for the community sports league

scenario.topic: Choose a mascot for the community sports league
scenario.opening_question: What qualities should our community sports league mascot emphasize to best represent us?

options.name: Red Fox with Dynamic Pose
options.upside: Energetic and agile image appeals to kids and adults
options.tradeoff: Common animal mascot, may not stand out regionally
options.concern: Some may find it too generic or overused in sports
options.best_for: Creating a lively and approachable team spirit

options.name: Steelworker Robot with Hard Hat
options.upside: Strong local industry tie-in and modern look
options.tradeoff: More complex design increases costume production time
options.concern: Might feel less warm or relatable to younger kids

options.name: Golden Eagle in Mid-Flight
options.upside: Majestic and inspiring symbol with broad appeal
options.tradeoff: Costume may be difficult to animate or wear comfortably
options.concern: Could be seen as too serious or formal for casual league

options.name: Cheerful Pineapple Character
options.upside: Fun, quirky mascot that stands out and invites smiles
options.tradeoff: Less traditional sports mascot, might confuse some fans
options.concern: May not be taken seriously by older players or sponsors
options.best_for: Creating a lighthearted and memorable community vibe

shared_context: The league has exactly 4 core decision-makers
The mascot will be used on uniforms, banners, and social media
Budget for mascot design and costume is moderate but limited

personas.background: Felix values community pride and wants the mascot to reflect local industry and toughness.
